## Why This Is Asked

- On-device inference and training constraints
- Federated learning, DP-SGD, secure aggregation

- Model quantization and latency budgeting
- Active learning and few-shot expansion
- Drift detection and rollback

## Code Example
```python
# Python: DP-SGD sketch for federated learning
def dp_sgd_step(model, batch, noise_multiplier, l2_norm_clip):
    # Compute gradients with clipping
    grads = compute_gradients(model, batch)
    clipped_grads = clip_gradients(grads, l2_norm_clip)
    # Add noise for differential privacy
    noisy_grads = add_gaussian_noise(clipped_grads, noise_multiplier)
    return apply_gradients(model, noisy_grads)
```

## Why This Is Asked
Accounts for practical on-device NLP with multilingual support, focusing on a narrow, actionable capability rather than broad models. It tests data labeling, privacy, and lightweight deployment trade-offs.

## Key Concepts
- On-device NLP with tight storage constraints
- Rule-based expansion vs. dictionary lookup
- Multilingual (EN/ES/DE) handling
- Privacy-preserving, no-network operation
- Lightweight evaluation and rollout strategies

## Code Example
```javascript
const dict = {
  "API": "Application Programming Interface",
  "CI/CD": "Continuous Integration/Delivery",
  "SSO": "Single Sign-On",
  "UI": "User Interface",
  "SDK": "Software Development Kit"
};

function expandAcronyms(text) {
  return text.replace(/\b(API|CI\/CD|SSO|UI|SDK)\b/g, w => dict[w] || w);
}
```

- How would you design a minimal labeling workflow to add new acronyms post-release?
